interval_ms: environment-only default; actual interval saved in every physical record
target: Actually delivered receptor-population events in this observation window
limitations: Some conditions occupy only one session per split.
Persistent windows within a session are correlated, not independent replicates.
Lateralized population delivery is not spatial object localization.
No natural-language intent or behavior target is fitted.
A nominal unilateral scene can become bilateral or silent as the free body moves; planned side is never a target.
Tap timing and emitter field strengths are engineering parameter sets; the sources are not calibrated concentrations or sound pressures.

The plume is upstream data from a different arena scale; it is not a cVA concentration. The following source is a different physical claim from a fixed source and is labelled as such. Nudge trains are engineering timings, and no direction code is claimed for them.
A following source can still become bilateral if the two antennae come within its declared range; delivered events, never the planned side, decide labels.

placement_reference.scope: Fixed initial placement only; no tracking or tethering

scope_additions: Borrowed upstream plume grid sampled at the funiculus (spatially and temporally structured)
Following sources that keep their declared offset relative to the measured receptor pose
Multi-tap nudges on the opposite foreleg and an alternating nudge, for turn-rich windows
Following unilateral odor/thermal sources on each side, several sessions per split
Repeated song-field and foreleg-nudge sessions in every split
Repeated strictly-unilateral fixed odor/thermal sources on each side
Repeated song-field and foreleg-nudge sessions in every split

placement_reference_v4.scope: Fixed initial placement only; no tracking or tethering

plume_provenance.model: Precomputed 2-D Navier-Stokes plume with Brownian inflow (upstream generator)

elicitation_round.reason_for_abstention: environment.py refuses to register wing-membrane, whole-thorax and labellum contacts to those populations; there is no physical route to elicit them

elicitation_round_2.method: repeats of the placement-verified strictly-unilateral fixed sources
elicitation_round_2.anchored_model_defect: As implemented, the anchored model re-places the source next to whichever receptor is sampled, so every receptor sees the same field and no side contrast is possible; recorded in the negative registry. Fixing it changes contract-hashed transduction code and would force a full re-collection.
